reason: A web-interface utility that provides a confirmed one-click control to stop and relaunch DeepSeek Harness, then automatically reconnects the page to the new host.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供带确认操作的一键重启按钮，并在服务恢复后自动重新加载页面。
summaries.en: Adds a confirmed one-click restart button to the DeepSeek Harness web interface and automatically reloads the page when the service returns.

capabilities: Adds a floating restart control to the DeepSeek Harness web interface
Exposes same-origin health-check and restart HTTP routes
Terminates and relaunches the current DeepSeek Harness process using its existing command line
Polls for the relaunched host and reloads the page
